info.name: Renivet Backend - Identity, Authentication, Sessions and MFA (REN2-21/23/24)
info.description: Version-controlled functional docs for implemented identity, password, session, MFA and logout routes. NestJS-generated OpenAPI is authoritative; tests remain handwritten. Synthetic data only; no cloud sync. Linear: REN2-21, REN2-23 and REN2-24.

item.name: 01 — Identity & Authentication
item.description: Public registration and password-session operations. No authentication is required to call these endpoints. Session cookie is HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, host-only, and Path=/.

request.description: Purpose: create a pending-verification account. Duplicate canonical emails receive the same neutral result and are not overwritten. Linear: REN2-21. Parameters: none. Body: email (valid address), password (8–128 characters). Authentication/permissions: public; none. Responses: 202 accepted; 400 AUTH_INPUT_INVALID; 429 AUTH_RATE_LIMITED; 503 AUTH_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; 500 AUTH_INTERNAL_ERROR. Synthetic example only.

exec: pm.test('new registration returns a neutral 202', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(202); });
pm.test('registration body does not reveal account state', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({ status: 'accepted' }); });

request.description: Purpose: verify duplicate-registration enumeration resistance. Linear: REN2-21. Parameters: none. Body: same synthetic email/password as registration example. Authentication/permissions: public; none. Responses: same 202 accepted body as first registration; validation/rate-limit/service errors use documented error envelopes.

exec: pm.test('duplicate registration remains neutral', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(202); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({ status: 'accepted' }); });

request.description: Negative validation example. Linear: REN2-21. Invalid body is synthetic. Expected 400 AUTH_INPUT_INVALID.

exec: pm.test('invalid passphrase returns a safe 400 envelope', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('AUTH_INPUT_INVALID'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include('short7'); });

request.description: Purpose: deny an unknown account without revealing existence. Linear: REN2-21. Parameters: none. Body: synthetic email/password. Authentication/permissions: public. Responses: 200 with authenticated user and Set-Cookie; 400 AUTH_INPUT_INVALID; 401 AUTHENTICATION_FAILED; 429 AUTH_RATE_LIMITED; 503 AUTH_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; 500 AUTH_INTERNAL_ERROR.

exec: pm.test('unknown identity gets generic 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('AUTHENTICATION_FAILED'); });
pm.environment.set('unknownFailure', JSON.stringify({ code: pm.response.json().code, message: pm.response.json().message }));

item.name: Password login — wrong passphrase has same failure

request.description: Negative authentication example proving wrong-password and unknown-account responses match. Linear: REN2-21. Synthetic verified account fixture is supplied only at runtime.

exec: pm.test('wrong passphrase uses the same 401 response as unknown account', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); pm.expect({ code: pm.response.json().code, message: pm.response.json().message }).to.eql(JSON.parse(pm.environment.get('unknownFailure'))); });

request.description: Positive authentication example. Linear: REN2-21. Requires an active, email-verified account with a synthetic Argon2id credential. Success returns a minimal user identity and __Host-renivet_session cookie.

exec: pm.test('verified password returns authenticated identity', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().authenticationState).to.eql('authenticated'); pm.expect(pm.response.json().user.id).to.be.a('string'); });

pm.test('cookie flags protect the session secret', function () { const cookie = pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie') || ''; pm.expect(cookie).to.match(/^__Host-renivet_session=[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}; Path=\/; Max-Age=1800; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax$/); pm.expect(cookie).not.to.match(/Domain=/i); pm.collectionVariables.set('sessionCookie', cookie.split(';', 1)[0].split('=', 2)[1]); });

item.name: Inspect active session and obtain CSRF proof (REN2-23)

request.description: Purpose: inspect the current minimal identity and obtain a per-session CSRF proof. Linear: REN2-23. Parameters/body: none. Authentication: opaque host-only session cookie. Permissions: session owner only. Responses: 200 authenticated identity and csrfToken; 401 AUTHENTICATION_FAILED; 503 AUTH_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.

exec: pm.test('active session returns minimal identity, CSRF proof and refreshed secure cookie', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().user.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(pm.response.json().csrfToken).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie')).to.match(/^__Host-renivet_session=[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}; Path=\/; Max-Age=(?:[1-9]\d{0,2}|1[0-7]\d{2}|1800); HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax$/); pm.collectionVariables.set('sessionCsrf', pm.response.json().csrfToken); });

request.description: Attach the signed-in account owner's synthetic Indian mobile number as an unverified contact. This operation requires the active session and session-bound CSRF proof; it does not send an SMS. The separate phone_verification challenge sends its OTP. Phone sign-in uses the distinct phone_login challenge purpose and requires a verified number. Linear: REN2-39 plus W1 phone OTP login.

exec: pm.test('phone is attached only as unverified contact', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(202); pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('accepted'); pm.expect(typeof pm.response.json().verificationRequired).to.eql('boolean'); });

item.name: 02 — MFA and Privileged Authentication (REN2-24)
item.description: Authenticator enrollment, session elevation and revocation. TOTP and recovery proofs are never reused as checkout OTP. All mutations require the active session cookie, exact Origin, same-origin fetch metadata and session-bound X-CSRF-Token. These runnable CI examples cover status, provisioning start, malformed proof and insufficient-step-up denial; full positive TOTP/recovery flows run in the disposable PostgreSQL API integration test.

item.name: Inspect MFA status without revealing factor material (REN2-24)

request.description: Purpose: inspect the current user's MFA state and remaining recovery-code count. Linear: REN2-24. Parameters: none. Body: none. Authentication/permissions: authenticated first-party session cookie; no domain role required. Responses: 200 not_enrolled/enrollment_pending/enabled and count; 401 AUTHENTICATION_FAILED; 503 AUTH_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; 500 AUTH_INTERNAL_ERROR. Secret, TOTP and recovery codes are never returned. Synthetic account only.

exec: pm.test('MFA status is private and contains no factor material', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.state).to.eql('not_enrolled'); pm.expect(body.recoveryCodesRemaining).to.eql(0); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Cache-Control')).to.eql('no-store'); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('secret'); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('recoveryCodes'); });

request.description: Purpose: begin a 10-minute TOTP enrollment and return its provisioning URI once. Linear: REN2-24. Parameters: none. Body: none. Authentication/permissions: active session plus exact allowlisted Origin, same-origin fetch metadata and session-bound CSRF proof. Responses: 200 enrollment_pending with one-time otpauth URI and expiry; 401 AUTHENTICATION_FAILED; 403 CSRF_VALIDATION_FAILED; 409 AUTH_MFA_ENROLLMENT_UNAVAILABLE; 429 AUTH_RATE_LIMITED; 503 AUTH_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; 500 AUTH_INTERNAL_ERROR. A pending or enabled factor prevents another enrollment. Synthetic test account only.

exec: pm.test('enrollment creates a one-time, short-lived authenticator setup response', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.state).to.eql('enrollment_pending'); pm.expect(body.provisioningUri.startsWith('otpauth://totp/')).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.expiresInSeconds).to.eql(600); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Cache-Control')).to.eql('no-store'); });

request.description: Purpose: verify an enrollment TOTP and activate MFA. This negative example sends malformed input and must not activate the factor. Linear: REN2-24. Parameters: none. Body: code must be exactly six decimal digits. Authentication/permissions: active session plus same-origin CSRF protections. Responses: 400 AUTH_INPUT_INVALID; 401 AUTH_MFA_PROOF_INVALID for an invalid/replayed valid-shape code; 403 CSRF_VALIDATION_FAILED; 429 AUTH_RATE_LIMITED; 503 AUTH_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; 500 AUTH_INTERNAL_ERROR. Valid activation rotates the session and returns ten recovery codes once. Synthetic invalid example only.

exec: pm.test('malformed enrollment proof is rejected without activation', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('AUTH_INPUT_INVALID'); });

request.description: Purpose: elevate a session using TOTP or one unused recovery code. This negative example verifies request validation only. Linear: REN2-24. Parameters: none. Body: six-digit TOTP or 26-character base32 recovery code. Authentication/permissions: active session plus same-origin CSRF protections. Responses: 400 AUTH_INPUT_INVALID; 401 AUTH_MFA_PROOF_INVALID for invalid/replayed proofs; 403 CSRF_VALIDATION_FAILED; 429 AUTH_RATE_LIMITED; 503 AUTH_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; 500 AUTH_INTERNAL_ERROR. Success rotates the session and returns a fresh CSRF proof. Synthetic invalid example only.

exec: pm.test('malformed step-up proof is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('AUTH_INPUT_INVALID'); });

item.name: Reject factor revocation without fresh MFA (REN2-24)

request.description: Purpose: revoke the active authenticator factor. This negative example runs before any valid MFA step-up and must deny. Linear: REN2-24. Parameters: none. Body: none. Authentication/permissions: active session, exact Origin, same-origin fetch metadata, CSRF proof and MFA step-up no older than 300 seconds. Responses: 200 revoked with cookie expiry; 401 AUTHENTICATION_FAILED; 403 AUTH_MFA_STEP_UP_REQUIRED or CSRF_VALIDATION_FAILED; 429 AUTH_RATE_LIMITED; 503 AUTH_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; 500 AUTH_INTERNAL_ERROR. Synthetic test account only.

exec: pm.test('factor revocation requires a recent server-side MFA step-up', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('AUTH_MFA_STEP_UP_REQUIRED'); });

request.description: Negative security case: cross-site origin and Fetch Metadata must fail closed and preserve the valid session. Linear: REN2-23. Parameters/body: none. Authentication: valid synthetic session. Responses: 403 CSRF_VALIDATION_FAILED; 401 AUTHENTICATION_FAILED.

exec: pm.test('cross-site logout is denied without ending the session', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('CSRF_VALIDATION_FAILED'); });

request.description: Positive logout: exact configured same-origin and session-bound CSRF proof required. Linear: REN2-23. Parameters/body: none. Authentication: active synthetic session cookie. Permissions: current session owner. Responses: 200 logged_out with expired secure cookie; 401 AUTHENTICATION_FAILED; 403 CSRF_VALIDATION_FAILED; 503 AUTH_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.

exec: pm.test('logout revokes session and expires host-only cookie', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('logged_out'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie')).to.match(/^__Host-renivet_session=; Path=\/; Max-Age=0; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax$/); });

request.description: Negative lifecycle case: the cookie secret cannot authenticate after successful server-side logout. Linear: REN2-23. Parameters/body: none. Authentication: previously logged-out synthetic session cookie. Responses: 401 AUTHENTICATION_FAILED.

exec: pm.test('logged-out session cannot authenticate again', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('AUTHENTICATION_FAILED'); });
